command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; PRE=$(state); echo pre_call_state=$PRE; test "$PRE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2-bidirectional-install.log; cat /tmp/phase2-bidirectional-install.log; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; A=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe prepare-abort-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$A"; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'probe=bidirectional-media-v1'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'prepared_after_prepare=true'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'active_after_prepare=false'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_prepare=false'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe start-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$B"; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'prepared_before_contexts=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'downlink_context_package=android'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'downlink_context_attribution=android'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'uplink_context_package=com.android.shell'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'uplink_context_attribution=com.android.shell'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'offcall_start_rejected=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'prepared_after_rollback=false'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'active_after_rollback=false'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_rollback=false'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'reprepare_after_rollback=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'prepared_after_final_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'active_after_final_abort=false'; POST=$(state); echo post_call_state=$POST; test "$POST" = "0"; rm -f /tmp/phase2-bidirectional-install.log; echo phase2_bidirectional_offcall_ok=true
